pages.title: Welcome to Nourished
pages.text:
Nourished adds a nutrition system that encourages eating a $(bold)varied diet$(). Each food group you consume contributes to your overall health and performance.

Eat well, sleep soundly, and your body will reward you.

pages.title: The Core Idea
pages.text:
There are $(bold)five food groups$(): Fruits, Vegetables, Proteins, Grains, and Dairy.

Maintaining each group provides $(#52c252)bonuses$(), while neglecting them causes $(#e05252)penalties$(). Balance is everything.

pages.title: Crafting This Book
pages.text: Combine a book with wheat to craft the Nourished Guide.
